summary: Opt-in Emberpath model provider for the fleet assistant.

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_EMBERPATH_URL
newOptionalEnv.description: Emberpath OpenAI-compatible base URL including /v1. Set with MAGNUS_EMBERPATH_API_KEY and MAGNUS_EMBERPATH_MODEL to add the opt-in emberpath assistant provider; unset keeps OpenRouter as the hosted default.

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_EMBERPATH_API_KEY
newOptionalEnv.description: Emberpath client API key (Bearer), ideally with actorId metadata for attribution.

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_EMBERPATH_MODEL
newOptionalEnv.description: Emberpath model name or alias used by the default hosted routes.
